name: FEKBD Addons for Elementor
author: fekbd

sections.description:
FEKBD Addons for Elementor gives you 20 polished, fast and fully free widgets for the Elementor page builder: headings, buttons, pricing tables, testimonials, team, counters, tabs, accordions, timelines, image comparison, logo carousel, post grid and more.

Every widget comes with ready-made presets and skins, responsive controls, soft (reduced-motion aware) animations and clean, accessible markup. Nothing is locked, there are no trial limits and no “upgrade to unlock” buttons inside the widgets.

👉 See every widget live

Why FEKBD Addons?

  • Free means free. All 20 widgets and all of their controls work in the free version.
  • Built for real websites. One-click presets and skins for real page sections, not just color swatches.
  • Light and fast. Each widget loads its own small CSS / JS file only on pages that use it.
  • Private. No tracking, no external requests, no icon fonts from a CDN.
  • Works with any theme. Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, Kadence, OceanWP and more. Elementor Pro is not required.

The 20 free widgets

  • Advanced Heading – eyebrow, sub-heading, { highlighted } words, gradient / outline / neon title styles, dividers, watermark text and entrance animations, plus 12 one-click presets.
  • Animated Text – typing, rotating, flipping and highlighted headline effects.
  • Dual Button – two buttons side by side with an optional “or” connector.
  • Advanced Button – icons, hover effects, badges and extra actions (copy, scroll, phone, WhatsApp link).
  • Icon Box – service and feature grids with many card layouts and a built-in SVG icon set.
  • Flip Box – cards that flip, slide or fade to show the back side.
  • Call to Action – centered, split, boxed, banner, strip and app-download layouts with an optional countdown.
  • Pricing Table – plans with a monthly / yearly switch, a featured plan and feature lists.
  • Testimonial Slider – reviews with star ratings, results metrics and platform badges.
  • Team Member Grid – team cards with social links and hover styles.
  • Counter Up – animated numbers and statistics.
  • Progress Bar – line, striped and circle skill bars.
  • Countdown Timer – count down to a launch, sale or event.
  • Advanced Tabs – horizontal and vertical tabs with icons.
  • Advanced Accordion – FAQ accordion with optional FAQ schema (structured data).
  • Timeline – a vertical timeline for history, processes and milestones.
  • Image Comparison – before / after slider with drag, hover, toggle, sweep, lens and fade modes.
  • Logo Carousel – client and partner logos as a grid, marquee or slider.
  • Post Grid – blog posts with card styles, category filter, pagination and “load more”.
  • Business Hours – opening hours with a live “open now / closed” status.

Turn off any widget you do not need under FEKBD Addons → Elements. Switched-off widgets are not loaded at all.

Need more? FEKBD Addons for Elementor Pro – 201 Elementor elements

FEKBD Addons for Elementor Pro is the premium edition by the same developer. It is a separate plugin; this free plugin works fully on its own and does not need it.

Pro takes you from 20 to 201 Elementor elements, plus the builders to make a complete website:

  • 201 widgets – every free widget, plus 181 more.
  • Header & Footer Builder with mega menus – 71 header and 62 footer designs.
  • Theme Builder for single posts, archives, search and 404 pages.
  • WooCommerce Builder and Shop Boost – product pages, swatches, AJAX filters, quick view.
  • Loop Builder for posts, products and custom fields.
  • 925-section library you insert straight from the Elementor editor.
  • Per-page asset loading, maintenance mode, White Label, translation and RTL ready.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor (version 3.20 or newer).
  2. In your dashboard go to Plugins → Add New, search for “FEKBD Addons for Elementor”, then click Install Now and Activate. Or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Edit any page with Elementor. You will find the widgets in the FEKBD Addons category of the widget panel.
  4. Optional: go to FEKBD Addons → Elements to switch individual widgets off.
sections.faq:
Does it need Elementor Pro?

No. All widgets work with the free Elementor plugin.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. The widgets work with any theme that supports Elementor, for example Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, Kadence or OceanWP.

Will it slow my site down?

No. The CSS and JavaScript of a widget are loaded only on pages where that widget is used, and switched-off widgets are not loaded at all.

Does the plugin collect any data or connect to external services?

No. The plugin does not track you, does not send data anywhere and loads no files from other servers.

Can I use it together with FEKBD Addons for Elementor Pro?

Yes. Both plugins can be active at the same time. When FEKBD Addons for Elementor Pro is active, its own versions of these 20 widgets are used: the free widgets are hidden from the Elementor panel (no duplicates), but pages that already use them keep working. FEKBD Addons for Elementor Pro can move those pages to its widgets in one click (with an undo), after which this plugin can be deactivated.

Where can I get help?

Please open a topic in the support forum or write to support@fekbd.com. FEKBD Addons for Elementor Pro customers get help at fekbd.com/support.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: FEKBD Addons has its own admin menu (right below Dashboard) instead of a page inside the Elementor menu.
  • New: Welcome page with a quick start guide, your elements, help links and the Pro overview in one place.
  • New: Elements page with on / off switches, search, “all on / all off” and a live demo link for every widget.
  • Fix: Documentation and help links now point to the right pages.
  • Bundled fonts for the admin screens (Big Shoulders Display and IBM Plex Sans, SIL Open Font License 1.1).

1.0.2

  • Fix: Elementor template styles in Tabs and Accordion are loaded with wp_enqueue_style() (no inline
  • Fix: FAQ and Business Hours JSON-LD are printed with wp_print_inline_script_tag().

1.0.1

  • Renamed to FEKBD Addons for Elementor.
  • New: works side by side with FEKBD Addons Pro. When FEKBD Addons Pro is active, the free widgets stay registered (existing pages keep rendering) but are hidden from the Elementor panel, so no widget is listed twice.
  • New: the settings screen says when FEKBD Addons Pro is active and hides the Pro links.
  • Security: escaping improvements. Saved Elementor templates in Tabs and Accordion are escaped with wp_kses() and an allowlist; JSON output uses default wp_json_encode() escaping; all output is escaped late.
  • Tweak: the Pro box on the settings screen is dismissed per user; the Elementor requirement notice shows only on the Plugins screen and the settings screen.

1.0.0

  • First release with 20 widgets.
